start.title: [TODO:ja] Teach Us to Pray
start.text:
[TODO:ja] The disciples approach quietly.
"Lord, teach us how to pray."

loud_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Not for Show
loud_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Prayer is not for the crowd.
It is for the Father.

empty_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Speak from the Heart
empty_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] The Father hears the heart, not noise.
Speak simply.

our_father.title: [TODO:ja] Our Father
our_father.text:
[TODO:ja] "Our Father in heaven,
hallowed be your name."

stranger_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] He Knows You
stranger_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He is near, not distant.
Call him Father.

bread.title: [TODO:ja] Daily Bread
bread.text:
[TODO:ja] "Give us this day
our daily bread."

hoard_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Trust Today
hoard_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Tomorrow is in his hands.
Ask only for now.

greed_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Enough Is Enough
greed_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He gives what you need.
That is enough.

forgive.title: [TODO:ja] Forgive Us
forgive.text:
[TODO:ja] "Forgive us our debts,
our failings, our sins."

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Come Into Light
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He already knows your heart.
Speak honestly.

forgive_others.title: [TODO:ja] As We Forgive
forgive_others.text:
[TODO:ja] "As we also forgive
those who sin against us."

wound_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Let Go
wound_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Mercy received must be given.
Open your hand.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Mercy First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] You were forgiven freely.
Forgive freely too.

deliver.title: [TODO:ja] Deliver Us
deliver.text:
[TODO:ja] "Lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Ask the Father to guard you

self_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Lean on Him
self_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] You are not alone in the storm.
Ask for his help.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Ask the Father to guard you

private.title: [TODO:ja] Go Into Your Room
private.text:
[TODO:ja] "When you pray, go to your room.
Shut the door. Pray in secret."

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] In Secret
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Your Father who sees in secret
will reward you.

ending.title: [TODO:ja] He Hears You
ending.text:
[TODO:ja] A small lamp burns beside you.
You are not alone here.
